toc.emptyDescription: Try a component name such as Button, Dropdown, Modal… or clear the search box.

intro.title: Need a complete screen?
intro.description: The catalog only shows single pieces. How a form, a table, dialogs and filters fit together into a real CRUD screen lives in the Customers screen — read it instead of copying the examples here.

button.title: Buttons
button.summary: Use it anywhere a click does something; to go to another page wrap a real link with asChild.

form.title: Forms and inputs
form.summary: Use it to collect validated data: fields wired to react-hook-form + Zod, errors shown right under the field.

select.title: Pick from a list
select.summary: Pick one value (Dropdown) or several (MultiSelect) from a fixed list, with a search box when the list is long.

pickers.title: Date and time pickers
pickers.summary: Pick a date, a date with time, or a time; month names, weekday names and the display format follow the selected language.

overlays.title: Dialogs and toasts
overlays.summary: Modal to view or act, ConfirmDialog to ask again before a risky action, FormModal for data entry, toast for transient messages.

table.title: Data table
table.summary: Show a multi-column list with pagination; loading and empty states are built in.

badge.title: Badges and avatars
badge.summary: Short status labels (Badge) and a user picture (Avatar).

feedback.title: In-page messages
feedback.summary: Callout for messages that live inside the page (warnings, load errors); EmptyState when there is no data yet; use a toast for transient corner messages.

progress.title: Progress and loading
progress.summary: Progress and ProgressCircle for a completion percentage, Spinner while waiting, Skeleton to hold the place of content that has not loaded.

controls.title: Switches and quick choices
controls.summary: Toggle for on / off, SegmentToggle to pick one of a few short options, Checkbox for independent choices.

errors.passwordMin: Password must have at least 8 characters

pickers.languageHint: Month names, weekday names and the date format change with the language (Settings → Language).
